event.canonical_title: Five Arrested in Terrorism Investigation Near UK Air Base Used by US Forces
event.summary: British police arrested five men on suspicion of terrorism and explosives offenses near RAF Fairford, a UK air base used by US forces. The arrests occurred after reports of three suspicious vehicles heading toward the military airfield. Homes in the vicinity were evacuated as bomb disposal teams conducted investigations.

timeline.title: UK-Iranian National Arrested in RAF Fairford Terror Investigation
timeline.summary: A dual UK-Iranian national has been arrested by counter-terrorism police in connection with a suspected terror plot involving RAF Fairford. This arrest marks the sixth related to the incident, which British officials believe may have involved Iranian planning. The individual, aged 27, was taken into custody as part of ongoing investigations following the earlier arrests of five others, who have since been released on bail.

event_overview.title: About Terrorism Investigation
event_overview.subject: Terrorism Investigation
event_overview.summary: This is a live UK Counter Terrorism Policing investigation into suspicious activity near RAF Fairford, a Gloucestershire airbase that supports U.S. Air Force operations. The inquiry began after reports of vehicles travelling toward the base; arrests have been made on suspicion of explosives offences and of preparing terrorist acts, but the investigation had not reached a public charging or trial outcome as of October 6, 2026.

facts.label: Start and status
facts.value: The investigation concerns an incident reported near RAF Fairford on September 27, 2026, and Counter Terrorism Policing described it as a live, complex inquiry on October 6, 2026.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: The initial arrests occurred in Whelford, Gloucestershire, after reports at about 12:45 a.m. of three vehicles travelling toward RAF Fairford.

facts.label: Investigating authority
facts.value: UK Counter Terrorism Policing is leading the investigation; its updates say specialist investigators examined the scene and pursued multiple lines of inquiry.

facts.label: Legal scope
facts.value: The arrests cited suspected Explosives Act offences and Section 5 of the Terrorism Act 2006. Section 5 covers conduct undertaken with the intention of committing, or assisting another to commit, acts of terrorism.

facts.label: Why RAF Fairford is significant
facts.value: RAF Fairford is in Gloucestershire and is home to the 501st Combat Support Wing headquarters and the 420th Air Base Squadron; the U.S. Air Force identifies it as its preferred European forward operating location for bombers.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline follows publicly reported arrests and bail developments in this investigation, not a definitive account of motive, responsibility, evidence, charges, or eventual court outcomes.
